Gray swept-back hair, round brass spectacles and mature intelligent face

requested_revision: Costume updated consistently across front, profile and back to read as an 1880s–1890s London investigator: Victorian frock-coat tails and lapels, double-breasted waistcoat, high white collar, burgundy cravat, watch chain, period trousers and leather boots.
Profile pose and face-detail view retained; facial identity, body scale and palette preserved.
Signature action now shows a connected throwing arm releasing the boomerang and the other hand gripping a blunt, clearly identified walking cane; no sword thrust in this pose.
Separated equipment reference panel distinguishes concept identity items from the source-game arsenal.

The art panel labels reference objects separately; it does not resolve the project-doc discrepancy or approve all items as moves.

approval_scope: Concept/model-sheet candidate only. The v2 approved reference remains active. This candidate does not approve sprites, moveset, animation, SMS palette conversion, integration, ROM or game delivery.
